usedFor: Bonusly holds recognition and Google Docs holds your records, so “Bonus Created” can run “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Bonus Created” in Bonusly, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Every bonus gets written into one shared document, a running record of recognition.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's existing content, so choose add to keep your log.
